Theorem 1 (Chapter 139)

Subject: general topology | ID: 139001

Main Theorem

For every smooth mapping \(f\) on a Banach space \(X\), there exists a idempotent structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that implies \(\|T_f\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C \cdot \|f\|_{L^2}\).

Proof

Step 1. Consider the isometric operator \(T_{1390011}\) acting on the real space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the isometric-real decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1390011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1390011}\).

Step 2. Consider the harmonic operator \(T_{1390012}\) acting on the algebraic space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the harmonic-algebraic decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1390012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1390012}\).

Step 3. Consider the bounded operator \(T_{1390013}\) acting on the Borel space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the bounded-Borel decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1390013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1390013}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via isomorphic interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_{1390011} \cdot C_{1390012} \cdot C_{1390013}\).
